compounds.name: dimethyl disulfide

ammonia.reason: Moderate deamination of amino acids by raw-milk flora and smear Brevibacterium, higher in raw-milk 24-week cheese.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw hay-milk and smear rind with phenols and short branched acids, but no sheep/goat 4-alkyloctanoic acids.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet and plasmin proteolysis in 4-6 month alpine paste, balanced by salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no blue methyl-ketone burst; 2-heptanone/2-nonanone only from lipolysis.

browning.reason: Good Maillard potential from proteolysis-derived lysine and residual galactose with pH 5.7 melt flow.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus citrate metabolism plus short-chain fatty acids in 34.7% fat paste.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: High total acids ~2774 ng/g with butyric ~30% and isovaleric 22% from lipolysis and Leu catabolism by smear bacteria.

creaminess.reason: High fat offset by 33% moisture and cooked firm protein network limiting oral fat coating.

crumbliness.reason: Cooked 52C pressed curd with pH 5.7 calcium-crosslinked matrix fractures more than crumbles, no heavy crystals.

firmness.reason: 33% moisture, cooked/pressed alpine body and 12-15C ripening produce dense hard texture.

floral_honey.reason: Low benzaldehyde detected and limited phenylalanine catabolism to phenylethanol/phenylacetaldehyde.

fruity.reason: Propanoic/hexanoic acids and methyl ketones give light fruity notes, but no ethyl esters detected.

goaty.reason: Cow hay-milk only, no caproic/caprylic goat signature; octanoic acid present only at low lipolysis level.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 3-methylbutanal plus propionic acid and pyrazines from 52C cook and alpine Propionibacterium activity.

melt.reason: pH 5.7 rennet alpine with intact para-casein and 34.7% fat flows well when heated, not acid-set.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 2-heptanol/2,3-butanediol and smear rind metabolism, but no 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one detected.

oil_off.reason: Free fat release on heating from 34.7% fat and coalesced fat pools in aged cooked curd.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked cheese with no guaiacol/phenol smoke markers; heating is curd cooking not smoking.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid among major acids plus ~95 mmol/kg lactic acid, buffered by pH 5.7 and proteolysis.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water stretching; rennet-cooked curd softens and flows rather than strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Dimethyl disulfide 20.9 ug/kg in PDO from methionine catabolism, low versus cooked washed-rind sulfurous types.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted but sweet impression from propionic acid, diacetyl and proline-rich peptides.

umami.reason: 4-month proteolysis releasing glutamate by Lactobacillus helveticus peptidases in raw-milk alpine.
